label: SIMULATION (models + datasheet limits), not a hardware test

checks.description: 1-Wire release to ESP32 VIH (0.75 VDD), worst bus, all probe leads 0.5 m
checks.limit_source: DS18B20: master samples within 15 us of slot start [datasheet]; master releases ~2 us after slot start

checks.description: 1-Wire low level while a DS18B20 pulls down (vs ESP32 VIL)
Lid switch closed: level at the ESP32 pin (LID_IN)
Home sensor active (open collector 0.2 V): level at the ESP32 pin
Strapping: GPIO12 (MTDI) at reset must read 0 for 3.3 V flash (WROOM-32E)
checks.limit_source: ESP32 datasheet strapping: MTDI = 0 -> VDD_SDIO 3.3 V; ESP32 datasheet VIL max 0.25 VDD [datasheet]

checks.description: Strapping: GPIO0 at reset reads 1 (SPI boot) with the panel button released
HBM 2 kV on a lid lead: peak current into the ESP32 pin clamp (through the 1 k series resistor)
checks.limit_source: ESP32 HBM 2 kV rating (assumed, module datasheet class): 2000 V / 1500 ohm peak [derived]

checks.description: IEC 61000-4-2 2 kV contact on a lid lead: peak current into the ESP32 pin clamp
checks.limit_source: ESP32 HBM 2 kV rating (assumed, module datasheet class): 2000 V / 1500 ohm peak [derived]; no TVS on the inputs
checks.detail: leads are inside the enclosure; exposure is only during servicing. Add a TVS array (e.g. per-input 5 V TVS) if leads are touchable

checks.description: IEC 61000-4-2 8 kV contact on a lid lead: peak current into the ESP32 pin clamp
checks.limit_source: ESP32 HBM 2 kV rating (assumed, module datasheet class): 2000 V / 1500 ohm peak [derived]; no TVS on the inputs
checks.detail: leads are inside the enclosure; exposure is only during servicing. Add a TVS array (e.g. per-input 5 V TVS) if leads are touchable

checks.description: THERMO_OK (thermostats closed) at the ESP32 input vs VIH (digital read)
checks.detail: margin is small; reading IO36 with the ADC (threshold ~1.4 V) avoids it (see S11 Monte Carlo)

notes: s09_ow_nom: manufacturer model(s) IRF4905,IRLZ44N,TL431 replaced by behavioural fit after convergence failure (s09_ow_nom: convergence failure: ['trouble with node "ctrl_p5v_dk"'])
Strap levels at reset: IO0 3.30 V, IO2 0.00 V, IO5 1.69 V, IO12 0.00 V, IO15 3.30 V. GPIO5/GPIO15 only set SDIO timing / boot-log; GPIO2 is don't-care when GPIO0 = 1.
Basin-full probe (ADC, 47 k pull-up): 47 k wet -> 1.65 V simulated; dry -> 3.3 V. Divider table in leak_divider.csv.
